files.decision: Retain residuals pending owner. Production source and line directives unchanged.
evidence: nt_event.c calls PendingKeyboardHistory before its handoff. Raw origin travels with the 6805 ring byte, held event, translation prefix and unread output; internal replies have no console receipt. Fresh extracted device fixture passed seven checks including wrap, prefix, replay and reset. Its host reset callback is controlled.
Reset6805and8042 snapshots pending user-origin output before clearing queues; mvdm_keyboard_reset_pending_irq cancels the delayed IRQ and the PIC line only for that case.
Real controller/PIC fixture: 90 assertions, 0 failures. Early EOI preserves unread 60h data, status reads do not consume it, ICW1 cancels it. Direct controller replies set output and status.
Original CPU reset arm names the private c_main.c interrupt map. cpu_interrupt(CPU_HW_RESET,0) reaches c_cpu_raise_event(CPU_RESET_EXCEPTION_MASK). Source checked; no fresh reset execution claimed.

In-memory EOI alternatives measured 23 points / 51 lines with duplicated pending-state clear, or 24 / 53 with a new goto. Existing structured block keeps a single pending-state clear and lock release.

controller.controller_reply: C0 returns input port; 20, AA, AB, D0 and E0 return their response bytes
controller.scope: Actual controller/PIC; normal and early EOI slot order, whole-device reset cancellation, controlled host callbacks, no BIOS ISR/timer acceptance

files.decision: Retain all three address-domain adaptations pending owner. Source and line directives unchanged.
evidence: MS_bop_F calls kb_setup_vectors. CCPU SAS initialization obtains non-null Start_of_M_area from host_sas_init. Table entries are read via a host pointer relative to that base.
sas_loadw takes a guest address. Entry 12 is at byte offset 12*sizeof(word) in that address domain. Casting the rebased host pointer to sys_addr would supply the wrong address.
video.c indexes stream_io_buffer through the dirty-count pointer and gfx_updt.c dereferences it. Both need host addresses. The adjacent BIOS busy field stays a guest sys_addr.
